summary: Frontend-only testing of VolunteerSummary on /staff-volontari. Set up a TEST event with 3 teams (req=20, req=5, no-req), 10 volunteers + 1 staff member via API, then verified the summary UI on Staff / Volontari / Da classificare tabs. All acceptance criteria validated: correct math (unique persona per team, staff excluded), event filter (specific vs 'Tutti gli eventi'), Mancanti red/green color, teams without req excluded with vol-sum-noreq note, bar in Tiffany #0ABAB5, auto-update after TeamMembersDialog mutation (volunteer remove) and team requirement edit, mobile 390 layout (3 boxes side by side, no overflow). Cleanup completed.

test_results.initial_specific_event: PASS - Necessari=25, Assegnati=10 (staff NOT counted), Mancanti=18 (red), Copertura=36%, bar width=36%, noReq note '1 team senza fabbisogno indicato (esclusi da Necessari e Mancanti).' visible
test_results.tabs_consistency: PASS - Same values across Staff and Volontari tabs (each tab maintains its own evFilter state)
test_results.tutti_gli_eventi_filter: PASS - Aggregates all org events; Necessari=25 (only TEST teams have req set), Assegnati=16 (10 TEST + 6 other events), 4 teams noReq shown
test_results.staff_excluded: PASS - Staff member in Team A not counted in Assegnati (10 instead of 11)
test_results.overfill_cap: PASS - Team B assigned 7 vs req 5 contributes 0 to Mancanti (max(0,req-n) rule); overall Mancanti=18 comes from Team A only
test_results.noreq_excluded: PASS - Team C (no req) is excluded from Necessari and Mancanti, shown in vol-sum-noreq note instead
test_results.auto_update_remove_vol_via_team_dialog: PASS - After removing volunteer(s) via TeamMembersDialog (team-member-remove-*) in Team tab, switching back to Volontari tab shows updated Assegnati (10 -> 8) without page reload
test_results.auto_update_team_req_edit: PASS - After editing Team A volontari_richiesti from 20 to 3 via EntityManager edit modal (field-volontari_richiesti + team-save), Volontari tab summary auto-updates (Necessari 25 -> 8, pct 36% -> 88%)
test_results.mobile_390_layout: PASS - 3 boxes (vol-sum-needed/-assigned/-missing) in grid-cols-3 side by side, same y position (within <5px), no horizontal overflow (sw=vw=390)
test_results.coverage_bar_tiffany: PASS - Inner bar is bg-[#0ABAB5] (Tiffany); width style = pct capped by Math.min(100, pct) in code (verified visually)
test_results.mancanti_color_rule: PASS - text-red-600 when Mancanti>0 (initial), text-emerald-600 when Mancanti=0 and req>0 (observed in prior iteration run with req edit)

seed_data_creation: Created and FULLY CLEANED UP: 1 TEST_ event, 3 TEST_ teams, 11 TEST_ persons, 11 staff links (10 volontario + 1 staff). All DELETEs returned 200/204. saas_usage.events_created was incremented by 1 then the event deleted (counter not auto-decremented by product; left as-is).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 110: VolunteerSummary on /staff-volontari verified. Key selectors: volunteer-summary, vol-sum-needed-value, vol-sum-assigned-value, vol-sum-missing-value, vol-sum-coverage, vol-sum-coverage-pct, vol-sum-noreq, people-event-filter, tab-staff/tab-volontari/tab-da-classificare/tab-team. TeamMembersDialog opens via edit-team-{id}; inside: team-member-remove-{persona_id}, team-members-search, team-add-member/'Aggiungi componente', team-member-row-{persona_id}, dialog-close-x. Each PeopleTable tab holds its own evFilter state (resets to 'all' on tab mount).
